headline: Executive order creates a new presidential commission called the President's Make America Beautiful Again Commission.
what_it_does: This executive order sets up a new commission inside the executive branch with this official name. No summary was provided, so the commission's exact goals, members, and powers are not described here. The title alone does not show whether the order changes any rules, funding, or services.
when_it_takes_effect: Signed July 3, 2025. The available information does not give a separate start date.
